---
title: "get_referral_code (protocol::referral)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_check: self, who
    q_check --> q_error: !self.has_referral_code(who)
    q_check --> q_return: self.has_referral_code(who)
    q_error --> [*]: abort referral_no_referral_code()
    q_return --> [*]: return *self.referrer_code.borrow(who)

    note right of q_check
        INV-001: Aborts if who has no referral code registered
        INV-002: Returns the code string associated with the address

content.content:
1→---
     2→title: "list_rebates (protocol::referral)"
     3→---
     4→stateDiagram-v2
     5→    direction TB
     6→    [*] --> q_init: self, who
     7→    q_init --> q_alloc: coin_types = empty(), amounts = empty()
     8→    q_alloc --> q_check: check user_rebates_records
     9→    q_check --> q_return_empty: !self.user_rebates_records.contains(who)
    10→    q_check --> q_load: self.user_rebates_records.contains(who)
    11→    q_return_empty --> [*]: return (coin_types, amounts)
    12→    q_load --> q_iter: user_rebates = self.user_rebates_records.borrow(who)
    13→    q_iter --> q_push: has next key
    14→    q_iter --> q_return_full: no more keys
    15→    q_push --> q_iter: coin_types.push_back(key), amounts.push_back(amount)
    16→    q_return_full --> [*]: return (coin_types, amounts)
    17→
    18→    note right of q_iter
    19→        INV-001: Output vectors coin_types and amounts have equal length
    20→        INV-002: Each amount corresponds to the coin_type at same index

title: "generate_random_string (protocol::referral)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_init: random, length, ctx
    q_init --> q_setup: generator = random::new_generator(random, ctx), chars = empty()
    q_setup --> q_iter: i = 0

    q_map --> q_alpha: idx >= 10
    q_digit --> q_push: char_byte = 48 + idx (ASCII 0-9)
    q_alpha --> q_push: char_byte = 87 + idx (ASCII a-z)
    q_push --> q_iter: chars.push_back(char_byte), i = i + 1
    q_return --> [*]: return string::utf8(chars)

    note right of q_map
        INV-001: Output contains only characters a-z and 0-9
        INV-002: Output length equals the input length parameter
        INV-003: Modulo bias exists (256 % 36 = 4), chars 0-3 slightly more likely
